# Coditation

> Coditation is a data, AI, and product engineering firm specializing in conversational AI, cloud-native architectures, and enterprise data solutions for startups and enterprises.

Coditation provides end-to-end engineering services across AI/ML, data pipelines, cloud platforms, and full-stack development. The team has deep expertise in conversational AI, data warehousing (Snowflake, BigQuery), and healthcare/martech verticals.

## Key Topics

- Conversational AI
- Data Engineering
- Machine Learning
- Snowflake
- AWS
- Google Cloud Platform
- Kubernetes
- ETL/ELT Pipelines
- Generative AI
- Cloud-Native Architecture
- Microservices
- Product Engineering
- Healthcare AI
- Data Warehousing
- DevOps

## AI & Conversational Solutions

- [Conversational AI & Generative AI Consulting](https://www.coditation.com/services/conversational-ai): Conversational AI and generative AI consulting for voice and chat interactions
- [Omnichannel Chatbot Development](https://www.coditation.com/services/chatbot-development): Omnichannel chatbot development with NLP/NLU for enterprise customer engagement
- [Prediction, Recommendation & Forecasting](https://www.coditation.com/services/prediction-recommendation-and-forecasting): AI engineering for prediction, recommendation engines, and forecasting solutions
- [Segmentation, Clustering & Cohort Analysis](https://www.coditation.com/services/segmentation-clustering-and-cohort-analysis): Segmentation, cohort analysis, and customer insights with machine learning

## Data Engineering & Cloud Platforms

- [ELT & ETL Data Pipeline Services](https://www.coditation.com/services/elt-etl-data-pipelines): ELT/ETL data pipelines using Databricks, Airflow, Dagster, Spark, and DBT
- [Snowflake Consulting & Development](https://www.coditation.com/services/snowflake-development-consulting): Snowflake consulting and development for data warehousing and cloud analytics
- [Google Cloud Platform Services](https://www.coditation.com/services/google-cloud-platform): Google Cloud PaaS services including BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and Dataflow
- [Amazon Web Services](https://www.coditation.com/services/aws): AWS PaaS/IaaS services for cloud-native and serverless product engineering

## Application Development & Infrastructure

- [Full Stack Development Services](https://www.coditation.com/services/fullstack-engineering): Full stack development with PWAs, web components, and real-time applications
- [Mobile App Development (iOS & Android)](https://www.coditation.com/services/mobile-app-development-ios-android): Native iOS and Android mobile app development with QA and performance engineering
- [Cross-Platform Mobile Apps (React Native & Flutter)](https://www.coditation.com/services/cross-platform-mobile-app-development-react-native-flutter): Cross-platform mobile apps using React Native and Flutter for iOS/Android
- [Application Integration & Connector Development](https://www.coditation.com/services/application-integration-connector-development): Application integration and connector development services with Docker and CI/CD
- [Kubernetes & Cloud-Native Platforms](https://www.coditation.com/services/kubernetes): Kubernetes and K8 for cloud-native apps, microservices, and container orchestration

## Industry Solutions

- [Healthcare & Life Sciences](https://www.coditation.com/industries/healthcare-life-sciences): Healthcare and life sciences AI solutions with HIPAA, HL7, and FHIR compliance
- [Martech Solutions](https://www.coditation.com/industries/martech): Martech solutions with AI, predictive analytics, and marketing automation
